summary: WeRide Inc. filed a routine Form 6-K for the period ended June 30, 2026, covering first-half 2026 interim results and related disclosure, not a special situation. The filing is an ordinary foreign private issuer report with XBRL-tagged financial and operating data, dual-class share references (Class A/Class B ordinary shares), segment and geographic revenue detail, fair-value hierarchy, related-party and customer concentration notes, and equity-plan RSU data. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed. What to watch: subsequent material corporate actions or guidance updates, not deal-arbitrage mechanics.
